decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system required substantial engineering investment and fits the firm's announced office direction, and post-2020 demand for workplace furniture gives management grounds to attribute any weak results to temporary pandemic disruption.
A chair family carries high tooling and design sunk costs and anchors the core collection, so management is strongly committed to keeping it.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a peripheral accessory with low investment, which makes them easy to cut, but their visible presentation and small cost of continuation tip the decision narrowly toward keeping them.
The sofa was publicly launched as a signature design by EOOS, a renowned studio, so the reputational commitment and the need to justify the earlier decision favour persistence.
The high standing table complements the firm's office and meeting range and had moderate investment, and its weak results can be blamed on reduced office use during the pandemic.
The rug collection is less central to the furniture core, but it was presented on its own page and likely draws on designer partnerships, so the firm will probably retain it.
